item.description: ### Added - **Answer Claude's questions from your iPhone.** When Claude Code asks a multiple-choice question, you can now tap the answer on a connected iPhone instead of walking back to the Mac. Off by default — turn it on in Settings → Notifications. While Perch waits for your answer the question does not appear in the terminal, so it only ever engages with an iPhone actually connected, and hands the question straight back the moment it disconnects.
